items.title: Monitoring global traffic with AWS Cloud WAN Flow Logs
items.summary: AWS Cloud WAN Flow Logs capture flow-level traffic across your global network. Learn how to create flow logs at the core network, edge, and attachment scopes, publish them to Amazon CloudWatch Logs, Amazon S3, or Amazon Data Firehose, and query them with Amazon Athena and CloudWatch Logs Insights to analyze cross-segment and cross-Region traffic and drops.
items.creator: Thaddeus Worsnop
